verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms Finix serves an llms.txt at docs.finix.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200, with a proper '# Finix Docs' header), and its doc pages are published as .md URLs. Finix also documents an MCP server, with a Claude Code setup guide, so agents can query its API docs directly. missing for 10: independent or community corroboration of agents successfully consuming these docs, and evidence of a full-content variant (e.g. llms-full.txt) or how complete the index is.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://docs.finix.com/llms.txt # Finix Docs
Ask an AI agent questions about the Finix API to get accurate, current answers.
This guide shows you how to use Claude Code with Finix MCP to ask questions about Finix APIs and get documentation-based answers.
